---
title: "An empty filename"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

Quarto builds a window for a block whose filename is empty, so the filter must
not build a second one around it, and the annotation pass must still find the
code block of every window.

```{.python filename=""}
a = 1
```

```python
b = 2 # <1>
```

1. An annotation.
